# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices from the old lichen crews run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold], old lab tech dorm, lower rack. The window shutter cranks by hand when the power drops. Ask at the canteen. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], room on the lee side of the gulch, away from the storm face. Will pay in filter cartridges. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Colony housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]SHUTTER FITTER[/bold] wanted for the after-storm repair round. Steady hands, own goggles, no fear of heights. - [bold]CAVE CREW[/bold] sought for the iron seams. See the foreman. Lamps supplied, company not guaranteed.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]RESPIRATOR FILTERS[/bold], rinsed and dried, good for one more storm. Five credits each or two for a hot meal. - [bold]WELDING VISOR[/bold], dark grade. The only thing that lets you read a gauge at noon under the giant. Twenty credits, firm.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: orange cat, the colour of the sky at noon, answers to nobody. Last seen by the Lambda fence. Do not go past the fence looking for her. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: work detail tag on the mine road. Handed in to the warden, as the rules require. We asked, and the owner's shift was not docked.
## Notices - The old lichen crews walk out to the first planting on the first clear morning after every storm, to see what is still growing. Bring water and goggles. Newcomers are welcome.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
